{
  "screen_decision": "include",
  "screen_rationale": "The study evaluates the concordance between rat and rabbit embryofetal development studies and human clinical outcomes for pharmaceuticals, reporting discordance rates and discussing clinical relevance, thus providing a quantitative measure of agreement.",
  "arm": "toxicology",
  "arm_evidence": "Embryofetal development (EFD) studies are performed to characterize risk of drugs in pregnant women and on embryofetal development.",
  "therapeutic_areas": [
    "reproductive",
    "cross-cutting"
  ],
  "areas_evidence": "Embryofetal development (EFD) studies are performed to characterize risk of drugs in pregnant women and on embryofetal development.",
  "model_type": "regulatory-dataset",
  "model_evidence": "Information on rat and rabbit EFD studies conducted for human pharmaceuticals submitted for marketing authorization to the European Medicines Agency between 2004 and 2022 was collected from the database of the Dutch Medicines Evaluation Board",
  "species": [
    "rat",
    "rabbit"
  ],
  "species_evidence": "In line with the ICH S5(R3) guideline, these studies are generally conducted in one rodent and one non-rodent species, commonly rats and rabbits.",
  "endpoint_class": "mixed",
  "endpoint_evidence": "For 55.6% of the compounds similar effects were observed in rat and rabbit EFD studies. Discordance was observed for 44.6% of compounds."
}
